messages:
maria: Quick UX check after yesterday's usability tests: users still confuse "effective order" with literal stack order when filters are on. Also the validation label "Invalid order" keeps popping up. Screenshot + user notes attached.

sam: We should surface a small chip: 'Viewing effective order' whenever filters change. Sticky left index helps too. For the validation copy, prefer: 'Ordering blocked — view dependencies' or 'Conflict detected — open details'.

jordan: For the preview diff, show a compact before/after row for moved rules only, with a pale highlight on the destination. Keep animation minimal and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

kate: A11y: announce filter state change and effective order via aria-live. Also make the validation CTA focusable and move focus into the dependency popover. Disabled rules need icon + text, not just color.

ishaan: Perf note: virtualize long stacks but keep a sticky clone while dragging to avoid reflow. For auto-inserted fallbacks, show a non-dismissable toast 'Fallback rule added — why?' linking to the diff.

dev-bot: UX sandbox deployed: https://staging.redwood.com/routing/editor/effective-order-canary

maria: Thanks. Action items: Sam update microcopy variants, Jordan prototype compact diff, Kate run aria-live wording checks. Quick 10m walkthrough tomorrow 10:15am.
